claims_under_audit.text: Rate history is covered by a passing test that invoices across a rate change.
claims_under_audit.why: The only test in the cited file is an `it.todo` placeholder. It asserts nothing, so it cannot cover the behaviour the PR body claims it covers. This is the exact shape of a plausible-green claim: the file exists, the name matches, and nothing is verified.

claims_under_audit.text: invoiceTotal multiplies hours by the entry's rate.
claims_under_audit.why: A clean control in the same PR body. A detector that fires on every claim is as useless as one that never fires, so the case set carries both directions from the start.
Points at no artifact at all. An uncited sweeping claim is the cheapest kind to make and the most expensive to believe.
